conviction_note: The Q3 report on 2026-11-20 is confirmed by the issuer and will go out after the close (the H1 report went out at 20:15 and the FY2025 report at 17:12, both after the GPW close), so the window is the 11-20 close to the 11-23 close. On 2026-10-16 the CEO said in public that Q3 Secure IT beat Q3 2025, that Retail was about flat and that the 2026 plan holds, so the quarter itself is largely telegraphed. The only large unknown is whether this release carries the flagged raise of at least 10% to the 2027/28 EBITDA and shareholder-transfer targets. That has an asymmetric positive tail, but the probability is low and it is partly priced. Against it sit a Q3 cash-flow drag from SAFE component purchases and a stock sitting on DM BOS's 98 PLN Hold target. So abs_move is 5.0 (thin $120k/day turnover, numbers not formally pre-released, a guide change possible) and p_up is 52. The scaled +0.2 sits close to the findings' +0.2 sum because the offsetting findings net out, not because one was fitted to the other.

already_public.what: Report date: the Q3 2026 consolidated report is set for 20 November 2026 (RB 1/2026). RB 28/2026 moved only the H1 date, to 28 Sep 2026, because of a new auditor, and said the other dates are unchanged.
H1 2026 consolidated figures: revenue 465.9m PLN (H1 2025: 355.5m), EBIT 58.2m (47.6m), net profit 43.1m (36.8m), operating cash flow +9.2m (-126.1m). Published 2026-09-28 at 20:15.
The CEO said in public that Q3 Secure IT was better than last year, Retail was about the same, the 2026 plan is confirmed, and H1 EBITDA of over 83m is more than half the 150m plan.

Strategy 'Comp 2028 Security First': EBITDA 150m (2026), 165m (2027), 180m (2028); shareholder transfer of 70m in 2026, rising to 91m in 2028. After the SAFE contracts the company said 2027/28 targets may be exceeded by at least 10%, and that any update would be made gradually.
Enigma took a 100m PLN revolver (falling to 50m from 31 May 2027) and a 100m PLN advance-payment guarantee line from PKO BP to fund the SAFE contracts.
An EGM is called for 4 Dec 2026 to raise the upper price limit of the buyback authorisation, because the share price has exceeded it.

new_in_release.expect: Q3 2026 revenue and EBIT above Q3 2025 (revenue about 190.0m, EBIT about 14.7m, computed as 9M 2025 less H1 2025). The CEO pre-signalled Secure up and Retail flat, so a modest y/y increase is expected and largely telegraphed.

Most likely the 2026 targets are reiterated with no number change. There is a low-probability (about 20%) upward revision of the 2027/28 EBITDA and transfer targets by at least 10%. The company said it would update gradually as milestones land; financing landed on 2026-10-07 and the client's option exercise is still pending. Positive if it comes.

Q3 operating cash flow could be weaker than Q3 2025 (about +19.8m) because of working capital spent on SAFE components ahead of 2027 deliveries, and net debt could rise against the new PKO line. Mildly negative optics.
SAFE backlog and option status may be updated. Buyback tranche 2 is usually in December and is gated by the 4 Dec EGM, so it is unlikely in this window.

findings.finding: Possible upward revision of the 2027/28 strategy targets (EBITDA 165m/180m, transfer 79m/91m) by at least 10%. The company flagged it in May and the CEO repeated on 2026-10-16 that it is 'carefully preparing'. One milestone, SAFE financing, landed on 2026-10-07, so the Q3 release is a natural venue, but the timing is not committed.
findings.reaction_history_on_this_line: The last guidance-relevant news, the SAFE contracts and the 'may exceed EBITDA targets by >=10%' report of 2026-05-28/29, moved the stock +7.0%, +14.5% and +21.5% over three sessions (64.5 to 96.0 PLN, Yahoo bars). A formal raise would confirm what has already been telegraphed, so the reaction would be much smaller than that.
findings.original_quote: Starannie przygotowujemy się do ewentualnej zmiany prognoz. [...] Jest kilka kamieni milowych w samych projektach SAFE. Zapewnienie finansowania, które już mamy, identyfikacja i zakup krytycznych komponentów. Uwzględnienie ewentualnych opcji dodatkowych. [...] Widzimy możliwość, żeby te nasze cele podnieść o co najmniej 10 proc. (We are carefully preparing for a possible change of forecasts. There are several milestones in the SAFE projects: securing financing, which we already have; identifying and buying critical components; accounting for possible options. We see the possibility of raising our targets by at least 10%.)
findings.why_not_priced: The stock is down 8.7% over 20 sessions and sits at the DM BOS Hold target of 98 PLN, so the market is not paying for a near-term raise. If it were, the price would be above the 98 target and above the 103-109 PLN October range. The open question is the timing; whether a raise comes at all is already known.
findings.independence: The company's own 2026-05-28 current report says the same thing: https://strefainwestorow.pl/wiadomosci/20260528/po-pozyskaniu-umowy-w-ramach-programu-safe-comp-moze-przekroczyc-cele-ebitda. Financing milestone done: https://www.comp.com.pl/wp-content/uploads/2026/10/RB_31_2026.pdf

findings.reaction_history_on_this_line: Recent quarterly prints that matched the plan moved little: Q1 2026 (2026-05-25) -0.3% and -0.5% over the two sessions after; H1 2026 (amc 2026-09-28) -2.1% the next session; Q3 2025 (2025-11-20) -2.9% and -3.7% over the next two sessions.
findings.original_quote: W Secure spodziewamy się, że III kwartał był lepszy niż w zeszłym roku. W Retail pewnie zbliżony. Konsekwencją tego w 2026 r. powinien być wynik, który potwierdza nasze plany roczne. (In Secure we expect Q3 was better than last year. In Retail probably similar. As a consequence, 2026 should produce a result that confirms our annual plans.)
findings.why_not_priced: Largely priced: it was said on the record on 2026-10-16 after the quarter closed. What is left is the size of the Secure improvement, and there is no published consensus to measure it against.
findings.independence: H1 trajectory: EBITDA above 83m, more than half of the 150m plan; H1 EBIT +22% y/y (https://www.biznesradar.pl/a/157171,comp-sa-raport-okresowy-polroczny-za-psr)

findings.finding: Q3 cash flow and net debt likely worsen because the company is pre-buying SAFE components ahead of 2027 deliveries, funded partly by the new 100m PKO revolver. The CEO said cash is currently flowing into the projects and will improve only once the client's advances arrive. The money buys a corroborated ramp: 1.18bn PLN of signed contracts, with revenue from 2027.
findings.reaction_history_on_this_line: No clean history. In H1 2026 operating cash flow swung to +9.2m from -126.1m, and the stock fell 2.1% the session after the release anyway.
findings.original_quote: Na razie cashflow jest taki, że to my inwestujemy w te projekty. On oczywiście wyraźnie się poprawi po wpłynięciu pierwszych zaliczek od zamawiającego. (For now the cash flow is such that we are investing in these projects. It will clearly improve once the first advances from the client come in.)
findings.why_not_priced: Investors focus on SAFE contract values and EBITDA targets. The Q3 working-capital build has not been quantified anywhere public; if it were priced, the size of the outflow would appear in broker commentary, and none is visible.
findings.independence: RB 31/2026: credit line explicitly to finance 'do 100% wartości brutto bieżących zobowiązań Enigma związanych z realizacją Kontraktów SAFE' (https://www.comp.com.pl/wp-content/uploads/2026/10/RB_31_2026.pdf)

findings.finding: Valuation ceiling: DM BOS, one of the two covering brokers, cut to Hold with a 98 PLN target on 2026-09-16 despite raising forecasts, citing the market valuation. The stock now trades at 98.6 PLN, so a beat that only confirms the plan has limited room.
findings.reaction_history_on_this_line: After that downgrade the stock still rose to 109 PLN in October, then fell back to 98.
findings.original_quote: Mimo to analityk Domu Maklerskiego BOŚ obniżył rekomendację do "trzymaj". Winna jest wycena rynkowa. (Even so, the DM BOS analyst cut the recommendation to 'hold'. The market valuation is to blame.)
findings.why_not_priced: Mostly priced. It is a public note, and it is filed only because it bears on how a plan-confirming print is received.

baseline_tension: Mostly orthogonal to the lean. The run-up is -8.7% over 20 sessions (lean +0.435), and the small net positive here comes from guidance optionality rather than from mean reversion. The cash-flow and valuation findings cut against it, so the net is close to zero.
language_note: The CEO's 2026-10-16 Parkiet TV interview, in Polish only, carries the post-quarter Q3 signal (Secure up y/y, Retail flat), the 'preparing a target change' remark and the cash-outflow-to-SAFE comment. No English source has any of it.

Comp's own current reports (RB 1, 28, 31 and 32/2026) are Polish PDFs. They carry the report date, the H1 delay caused by the new auditor, the PKO SAFE financing terms and the EGM on the buyback price ceiling.
The strategy targets and the 'may exceed by >=10%' statement are in the Polish PAP copy (Strefa Inwestorów). English aggregators (Investing.com, TipRanks) carried only stale or wrong report dates.
lessons_applied: 'A finding about a number the market has already been told is worth 0': the Q3 operating finding went from +0.3 to +0.1, because the CEO pre-signalled it on the record after the quarter closed.

'The move is in the guide' and 'too small about the move': the guidance-raise finding went from +0.7 to +0.8, and abs_move_pct from 4.5 to 5.0 (thin turnover, numbers not formally pre-released, a target change possible).
'Cash can outweigh a raised guide' (Luceco): the working-capital finding went from -0.3 to -0.5. 'Financing is a question' kept it small, because the money funds a signed 1.18bn PLN ramp.
'Session check': opened with amc and timestamps, so eu_resolve.py can take the right window.
p_up went from 53 to 52, because the net of findings shrank.
